checks.name: all-outline-vertices-project-from-plane
checks.detail: Every footprint vertex has z=0 and projects to the current spec; footprint is not a spatial plane boundary.

checks.name: A-in-plane-B-not-in-plane-and-distinct
checks.detail: z(A)=0, z(B)=1; projected A inside and B above/outside.

checks.name: unique-spatial-intersection-is-A
checks.detail: Line (t,0,t) meets z=0 iff t=0. It is oblique, not inferred perpendicular; finite-outline crossings are not intersections with the plane.

checks.name: all-three-visibility-pieces-match-line-and-source-order
checks.detail: Undotted lower-window break at [225,100]; dashed break-to-A, solid A-through-B. No construction dot at either outline crossing.

limitation: Scratch affine/source-incidence checks supplement native 2D assertions; they are author evidence, not independent approval or a new renderer.
